Valid, fixed in the latest push. A Retry click carries no attachments of its own: protobuf decodes the omitted `images` field as `[]`, so `images ?? retry.images` kept the empty list. The retry now uses `images?.length ? images : retry.images`, so the failed start's attachments go to the retried sandbox unless the response actually carries some. Covered by `keeps the original attachments when Retry arrives with the webview's empty image list` in `SdkController.test.ts`, which sends Retry with `[]` and fails without the fix.

The same push merges `main` into this branch (the only conflict was in `state-keys.ts`, where `main` removed the focus-chain setting next to the new cloud keys). On the merged result, the full extension type check, vitest (1,452), `test:cloud` (23), the bun unit tests and the webview tests (584) all pass.

Fair catch. Before this PR a `metadata: null` clear was encoded as `{}` and the daemon wiped the record; my rewrite sent a literal `null`, which `asPlainRecord` decodes as omitted, so the clear became a no-op. No desktop or CLI caller passes `metadata: null` over the hub today, but it was a semantic change this diff introduced, so restored the `{}` encoding in 3e428e6dc and added a test for it.

This one is pre-existing and out of scope for this PR. The manifest handling lives in `UnifiedSessionPersistenceService.updateSession`, which this PR does not touch, and the behavior is the same on main. It is also not reachable from any product surface: the desktop sidebar runs the new name through `normalizeSessionTitle`, which turns an empty string into `undefined`, so a clear is never sent, and `cline history update` requires a non-empty `--title`. If we add a reset-to-auto-title affordance later, the fix is a one-line `delete manifestMeta.title` in the persistence service, but I would rather keep this PR to the hub transport bug it is fixing.
